title: עולא בר זכאי חולין

paragraphs: Ulla bar Zakkai, Ḥullin. Tosafot 52a, 'It was uprooted,' appears to support this, objecting to Rav Kahana and R. Ammi from Ulla bar Zakkai. But the Gemara says 'Ulla said: ben Zakkai said.' Rashi likewise says he does not know who bar Zakkai is. Otherwise he should have written that he did not know Ulla bar Zakkai. Many Shas figures are unidentified; here the issue is that ben Zakkai lacks a personal name: is it R. Yoḥanan ben Zakkai or another son of Zakkai? Yuḥasin erred by understanding Ulla as Zakkai's son.
